The post does not itself assess evidence strength; confidence rests on the linked materials.

S5: The authors use constructed dilemmas in which each option maps to an underlying value, then infer aggregate preference rankings from many pairwise choices. They compare several models, test whether rankings depend on who is affected, and compare stated with revealed preferences. The proposed link from value rankings to risk is not directly tested, so claims about predictive use remain exploratory.
